description: Net LHV electrical efficiency as a tabulated part-load curve plus a linear ambient-temperature derate. Breakpoints generated from the F1a quadratic eta(PLR)=eta_rated*(b0+b1*PLR+b2*PLR^2).

unit.name: GE LM6000-class simple-cycle gas turbine (~43 MW)
unit.source: Walsh & Fletcher (2004), Gas Turbine Performance, 2nd ed., Blackwell; F1a EC109

eta_rated.note: LHV net electrical efficiency at ISO (PLR=1, 15 C)

f_amb_coeff.note: Ambient derate: eta scaled by (1 - coeff*(T-T_ref))

eta_breakpoints.note: Net LHV efficiency at each PLR breakpoint, 15 C
